name: feedback-server
description: Agent-first setup and management for FeedbackKit products, feedback, waitlists, activity, roadmaps, releases, and notifications.

interface.shortDescription: Onboard and manage app feedback with your Agent.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to FeedbackKit for guided app setup, Feedback service management, waitlist invitations, and risk-based confirmations.
defaultPrompt: Set up FeedbackKit for my app and guide me through the next step.
List my apps and summarize unresolved feedback.
Review recent waitlist signups and identify the next follow-up actions.
Draft a reply to recent feedback and show me before sending.
Review roadmap items and draft the next changelog.

feedback-server.title: Feedback Server
feedback-server.description: Manage FeedbackKit products and feedback through a local MCP server with risk-based confirmations.
